newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mysterious arsonists target cars in French city.
newsitem.headline: Mysterious arsonists target cars in French city.

text.p: Arsonists were in action for the sixth consecutive night in a puzzling wave of suburban violence in the French city of Tours, police said on Tuesday.

Six cars and a mobile home were destroyed during the night, taking to about 40 the number of vehicles attacked since a youth of North African origin was shot in the head last week and went into a coma.

Police said the attacks could be in retaliation for the unexplained shooting but they did not rule out other possibilities. They said two people have been jailed over the attacks and two others were in custody awaiting trial.
